I've analyzed the three key documentation files that define the Lyra AI system:

1. PERSONALITYBEHAVIOUR.md - Defines personality guidelines and behavioral traits (Friendly, Chill, Playful, Direct, Custom)
2. LYRA_BRAIN.md - Outlines the cognitive architecture with mental processing cycle
3. REQUIREMENTS.md - Comprehensive requirements for local-first operation, privacy, identity preservation, security, etc.

All three files are properly formatted in Markdown and provide complete foundational materials for implementing the Lyra AI system. They cover personality definitions, cognitive architecture, and comprehensive requirements from technical implementation to security constraints. No additional development or documentation appears necessary at this point.
